atom.description: The primary display and body typefaces in author CSS MUST NOT be drawn from @impeccable/constraint-font-blacklist (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Helvetica Neue, Space Grotesk, DM Sans, Nunito, Poppins, Open Sans, Lato). These fonts are the statistical mode of LLM-generated and shadcn/Tailwind-default output and produce a visually undifferentiated 'commodity' result.
